Name: Light Switch
Author: holythesea
Description:
Turn off the ~ambiently~ dark lighting around the valley with a button toggle. Also includes configuration options to disable the fog layer in the Mines as well when the lights are on. Supports integration with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11026]Toolbar Icons[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url].

This is my first SMAPI mod and it's not exactly thoroughly tested and I have no idea how it would behave on multiplayer. However, I have seen someone request a mod like this before for accessibility reasons, so maybe this will help someone out (or you can just run through the really dark floors of the mines hehe). If there are any other prohibitively-dark areas of the game feel free to leave a comment! I also accept PRs and improvements to this mod. Source code is available on GitHub [url=https://github.com/holy-the-sea/LightSwitch/]here[/url]﻿.
